changes.text: The tab strip stays reachable by Tab when `active` matches no tab: the first button tab becomes the tab stop (before, every button tab got `tabindex="-1"`).
Segment borders, tab-number and stat margins and the skip link position use logical properties (`border-inline-*`, `margin-inline-end`, `inset-inline-start`), so the bar mirrors under `dir="rtl"`.

On keyboard-less devices (`@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)`) the command button shows a decorative `search` icon in place of the ⌘K chip, which `Kbd` now hides there, so the tap target is never empty.
Link tabs and the skip link no longer show the global animated `a::before` underline from `theme.css`.

The command shortcut is registered in the `shortcuts` registry as `ss:topbar-command` with keys `mod+k`, so it lists in `ShortcutsHelp` and obeys `setEnabled()` / `remap()`. It now fires on the platform modifier only: Ctrl+K no longer triggers `onCommand` on macOS (restore it with `shortcuts.remap('ss:topbar-command', 'mod+k, ctrl+k')`).
The command button's `aria-keyshortcuts` matches the platform (`Meta+K` on Apple, `Control+K` elsewhere; was `Meta+K Control+K`), and the ⌘K chip renders through `Kbd`.
The active-tab wash derives from `--ss-accent` (`color-mix(in srgb, var(--ss-accent) 6%, transparent)`) and follows the theme; it was hardcoded to the dark-mode green `rgba(102, 239, 115, .06)`.
The skip link's vertical padding reads the new `--ss-chip-py` token instead of the removed `--ss-badge-py` (same values, rendering unchanged).

Link tabs: `tabs` accepts `{ id, label?, href? }` objects (exported as `TopbarTab`) next to plain strings. A tab with `href` renders as a real `<a>` with `aria-current`, and `label` can differ from the `id` passed to `onTab`.
Optional chrome: `services` (`true`, `false` or `{ up, total }`) and `clock` (`false` removes the segment and its interval) props, and `stats={[]}` removes the stat segments.
The ⌘K button and the Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcut exist only when `onCommand` is provided; without it the button is not rendered and the browser default is left alone.

The tab strip shrinks and scrolls horizontally instead of pushing the right-side segments off screen when the tabs outgrow the bar. The collapse breakpoints (stats below 720px, tabs below 520px) are documented.
`ariaLabel` prop names the tab-strip `<nav>` landmark (default `Primary`).
The global `keydown` listener is guarded for environments without `window` (SSR safety).
Segment gaps and stat-key margins read the spacing tokens `--ss-s-2` and `--ss-s-1` instead of hardcoded pixels (visually unchanged).
The default `user` is `admin@hub.home` (was `rafael@hub.home`).
The root element is a `<header>` (was a `<div>`) and the tab strip is a `<nav aria-label="Primary">`. The ⌘K chip and the user chip are real `<button>` elements instead of `<div>`s.
A "Skip to content" link is the first focusable element; `skipTarget` sets its anchor (default `#main`).
The tabs use a roving tabindex: the active tab is the single tab stop, arrow keys move focus (wrapping) and Home/End jump to the ends.
`onCommand` fires from the ⌘K button and from Cmd/Ctrl+K; `onUser` fires from the user button, and a `userMenu` snippet replaces that button.
`brand` snippet replaces the built-in logo and name, and `stats` (`{ key, value, title? }[]`) replaces the built-in cpu/mem/net segments.
`sticky` prop (default `true`); set it to `false` for a bar that scrolls with the page.
Responsive collapse: the stat segments hide below 720px and the tab strip below 520px. Tabs and buttons keep a minimum height of `--ss-s-6` for a 24px hit target.
The styles ship scoped inside the component instead of in the global `theme.css`.
`size` prop (`sm`, `md`, `lg`); when unset it inherits the global size. The root renders the resolved value as `data-size-variant`.
The active tab sets `aria-current="page"`, and the tab numbers, the status dot and the ⌘K chip are hidden from assistive technology.
Tab and segment hover backgrounds use `--ss-hover` instead of a hardcoded white wash, so they are visible in the light theme.
The root class is `ss-topbar` (was `hub-topbar`) and the tokens it reads are `--ss-*` (were `--hs-*`).
New component: a top bar with a brand mark, a numbered tab strip (`tabs`, `active`, `onTab`), status and stat segments, a `user` chip and a live clock.
